'''Charky''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] who was orphaned during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Charky was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and one of ten young orphans abducted from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He spoke in short sentences. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] woman [[Kuvuta Pindi]] took the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to supply the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]] with [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. During a stopover on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], Pindi, posing as the orphan's blind minder, fooled the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] and [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] biker [[Gizman|Gizz]] into taking them to the rendezvous point of [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. Onboard the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]], Charky and the other younglings were restless, and Gizz stuffed Charky into an storage locker, telling the other younglings that it was an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Once on Foless, the Jedi and the orphans parted ways, but Gizz realized that Pindi was faking her affliction and gave chase. Charky noticed the swoop biker was following them. Kungurama forced the [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]] to crash. Pindi then grabbed Charky as a hostage, but the Trandoshan bit her [[Limb/Legends|arm]], forcing her to drop the knife and flee. She was later [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Charky and his fellow orphans found homes with new families.

==Behind the scenes==
Charky appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' young readers series.
